title: 散文 13
content:
Addicted To Your Kisses!
I was length warned against addictions,
Time and time again,
But this time all the warnings,
Proved to be in vain!
You kissed me and I loved it,
And I wanted you to kiss me some more!
You said you didn't mind it,
That is what your mouth is for!
So, again and again, I let you kiss me,
And I loved it so!
Now, I am addicted,
And all I want is more!
I love the sweetness of your lips!
It's something I can't do without!
That's the reason I fly like a honey bee,
Around your sweet, sweet mouth!
So, now, I am addicted,
And guess who doesn't care.
I'm just glad that when you kiss me,
There's plenty more there!
